summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce that its board maintained the 13.00% per annum dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA) and declared daily cash dividends of $0.0516 per share for August 2026, totaling $1.0836 per share for 21 business days. The filing provides guidance that distributions not from earnings and profits will be treated as tax-deferred return of capital for U.S. investors and exempt from U.S. withholding tax for non-U.S. investors. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
